lesson_fields.title: If / Elif / Else
lesson_fields.summary: A condition decides which block of code runs. if tests a case, elif tests another one, else catches everything remaining, and indentation marks the block.
lesson_fields.summary_fr: Une condition choisit le bloc de code execute. if teste un cas, elif en teste un autre, else attrape tout le reste, et l'indentation marque le bloc.
objectives: Use else as the default branch
Read a condition and predict which branch runs
objectives_fr: Utiliser else comme branche par defaut
Lire une condition et prevoir la branche executee

steps.title: Making a decision
steps.content:
An **if** statement runs a block only when its condition is True.

```python
if age >= 18:
    print("Adult")
```

The indented line belongs to the block. When the condition is False, Python skips it.
steps.content_fr:
Une instruction **if** execute un bloc seulement si sa condition vaut True.

```python
if age >= 18:
    print("Adult")
```

La ligne indentee appartient au bloc. Quand la condition vaut False, Python la saute.

question.text: When does the block inside an if run?
question.text_fr: Quand le bloc place dans un if s'execute-t-il ?
question.explanation: The block runs only when the condition is True.
question.explanation_fr: Le bloc s'execute seulement si la condition vaut True.
question.hint_prompt: What value must the condition have?
question.hint_prompt_fr: Quelle valeur doit avoir la condition ?

choices.text: Only when the condition is True
choices.text_fr: Seulement quand la condition vaut True
Toujours, quelle que soit la condition

choices.text: Only when the condition is False
choices.text_fr: Seulement quand la condition vaut False

hints.text: The condition acts like a gate.
hints.text_fr: La condition agit comme un portail.

steps.title: Elif and else
steps.content:
Use **elif** to test another condition when the first one is False, and **else** to catch every remaining case.

Only one branch runs: the first one whose condition is True. The else branch has no condition at all.
steps.content_fr:
On utilise **elif** pour tester une autre condition quand la premiere vaut False, et **else** pour attraper tous les cas restants.

Une seule branche s'execute : la premiere dont la condition vaut True. La branche else n'a aucune condition.

question.text: The if condition is False and an elif condition is True. What happens?
question.text_fr: La condition du if vaut False et celle d'un elif vaut True. Que se passe-t-il ?
question.explanation: Python skips the if and runs the first branch whose condition is True.
question.explanation_fr: Python saute le if et execute la premiere branche dont la condition vaut True.
question.hint_prompt_fr: Quelle branche est testee en second ?

hints.text: Only the first True branch wins.
hints.text_fr: Seule la premiere branche vraie est retenue.

steps.title: Worked example: from marks to a grade
steps.title_fr: Exemple resolu : des notes a une appreciation

steps.title: Your turn: read the grade
steps.content: The same three-branch test is used, with a mark of 40.
steps.content_fr: On reprend le meme test a trois branches, avec une note de 40.

question.text: With mark = 40, which grade is stored?
question.text_fr: Avec mark = 40, quelle appreciation est stockee ?
question.explanation: 40 is not 70 or more, and not 50 or more, so the else branch gives F.
question.explanation_fr: 40 n'atteint ni 70 ni 50, la branche else donne donc F.
question.hint_prompt: Check both tests before the else.
question.hint_prompt_fr: Verifie les deux tests avant le else.

hints.text: Is 40 greater than or equal to 50?

steps.title: Check: indentation matters
steps.content: The indentation shows which lines belong to a branch. If the spacing is wrong, Python reports an error and stops.
steps.content_fr: L'indentation montre quelles lignes appartiennent a une branche. Si les espaces sont mauvais, Python signale une erreur et s'arrete.

question.text: What happens if the indentation of a block is wrong?
question.text_fr: Que se passe-t-il si l'indentation d'un bloc est incorrecte ?
question.explanation: Wrong indentation makes the program invalid, so Python stops with an error.
question.explanation_fr: Une mauvaise indentation rend le programme invalide, Python s'arrete donc avec une erreur.
question.hint_prompt: Can Python read a block without clear spacing?
question.hint_prompt_fr: Python peut-il lire un bloc sans espacement clair ?

hints.text: Indentation is part of the syntax.
hints.text_fr: L'indentation fait partie de la syntaxe.

steps.title: What to keep
steps.content: An if block runs when its condition is True. elif tests another case, else catches the rest, and only the first True branch runs. Indentation defines the block.
steps.content_fr: Un bloc if s'execute quand sa condition vaut True. elif teste un autre cas, else attrape le reste, et seule la premiere branche vraie s'execute. L'indentation definit le bloc.

questions.text: Which keyword tests another condition after an if?
questions.text_fr: Quel mot-cle teste une autre condition apres un if ?
questions.explanation: elif tests a second condition after the first one fails.
questions.explanation_fr: elif teste une seconde condition apres l'echec de la premiere.
questions.hint_prompt: It is a short form of else if.
questions.hint_prompt_fr: C'est une forme courte de sinon si.

hints.text: It starts with the letters el.
hints.text_fr: Il commence par les lettres el.

questions.text: With x = 7, what does `if x > 10: print("big") else: print("small")` display?
questions.text_fr: Avec x = 7, qu'affiche `if x > 10: print("big") else: print("small")` ?
questions.explanation: 7 is not greater than 10, so the else branch prints small.
questions.explanation_fr: 7 n'est pas superieur a 10, la branche else affiche donc small.

questions.text: When several branches are True, which one runs?
questions.text_fr: Quand plusieurs branches sont vraies, laquelle s'execute ?
questions.explanation: Python runs only the first branch whose condition is True and skips the others.
questions.explanation_fr: Python execute seulement la premiere branche vraie et ignore les autres.
questions.hint_prompt: Python reads the branches from the top.
questions.hint_prompt_fr: Python lit les branches du haut vers le bas.

choices.text: The first one whose condition is True
choices.text_fr: La premiere dont la condition vaut True

questions.text: A mark of exactly 50 is tested with `mark >= 50`. Which grade follows from the lesson?

questions.explanation_fr: Le signe >= inclut l'egalite, 50 est donc accepte et la note vaut B.

hints.text_fr: Le signe >= signifie superieur ou egal.
